title: Checklist surface: on the dashboard when application-dashboard is applied, on the settings page when not
description: A first-run checklist renders on the dashboard-top anchor when application-dashboard is applied (open by default, so a new principal sees the outstanding items at a glance) and collapses to a settings-page anchor when application-dashboard is not applied (closed by default, so an existing principal reaching the settings surface can expand it). The collapse contract is a <details> element whose open state mirrors the anchor choice: dashboard-top -> open, settings-page -> closed. The checklist enumerates the applied tour surfaces with a link back to the restart-tour affordance on the settings surface. The blueprint contributes the anchor slot contract (ADR-2703) and the surface conditionality, not the checklist items.
rationale: Per visual round 4 spec (2026-09-06) section 5.5, REQ 3 of the onboarding-tour blueprint.
